Avi: quick note from onboarding comet-36k (int4). Failures only when context > 32k and prefetch-window=12288. float32 is clean.
Rhea: can you paste the repro and quant tag?
Avi: branch release/serve-v3, quant tag: int4-v2. repro:
```bash
./tools/long_prefill --model comet-36k --quant int4 --context 36000 --prefetch-window 12288 --seed 11
```
Avi: minimal log: `prefetch push shard=2 id=0xdead req=0xbeef` then later `handshake ack shard=2 id=0xbeef` but we saw token mismatch at ~32512
Marcus: try PREFETCH_SYNC=1 and --force-kernel=scalar to control timing. If scalar matches float, it's scheduling.
Avi: ran that: scalar normalizes to float baseline, async+vector reproduces. Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/comet_prefill/1860001234.tar.gz
ci-bot: longprefill job queued (job: lp-94001).
Rhea: plan: run small matrix PREFETCH_WINDOW={8192,12288,16384} KERNEL={scalar,vector} ROTARY_RESCALE={adaptive,legacy}; capture kv-fingerprints and rope-phase. If consistent, add lightweight handshake id validation before applying prefetch entries.
Marcus: I'll bisect vector kernel commits if matrix shows correlation.
Avi: tracking in INF-1533. Will post results when matrix completes. :rocket:
